rows.capability: Gantt schedule: task bars, progress, milestones, finish-to-start dependencies, now line, grouped bounded rows
rows.owner: aeris_charts_engine general_layout/gantt.rs; chart_input.rs wheel row scroll; WASM/TypeScript layout input
rows.referenceApi: series.custom renderItem rect/polygon on time xAxis and category yAxis, markLine now
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_timeline_calendar.spec.mjs Gantt geometry pair and bounded wheel/End/Home row-scroll test; general_layout.rs gantt paint, hit, tooltip, accessibility and bounded-row tests; persistence.rs layout round trip
rows.supportedCombinations: Temporal UTC millisecond tasks with optional progress 0..1, optional group, finish-to-start dependencies by id, zero-length milestones, optional host-supplied now; one layout pane
rows.differences: ECharts has no Gantt series; the reference is a custom series. Aeris draws bars, progress, milestones, elbow dependency arrows and a host-supplied now line in one ordered frame; the engine never reads the clock. Rows are bounded to the pane and scroll by wheel inside the engine, and keyboard focus reveals the focused task. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms normalized start/end positions and row order for every task against convertToPixel. Resize-by-drag editing, other dependency types and calibrated visual review remain open.

rows.capability: Calendar heatmap: year day grid, week start, locale labels, UTC days, color scale and legend, per-day hits and keyboard
rows.owner: aeris_charts_engine general_layout/calendar.rs; TypeScript accessibility grid_stride navigation
rows.referenceApi: calendar coordinate system, series.heatmap coordinateSystem calendar, visualMap continuous
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_timeline_calendar.spec.mjs calendar grid pair, empty-day hit and week/day keyboard test; general_layout.rs UTC, week start, leap year, locale labels, stride and empty-day focus tests
rows.aerisApi: add_layout_series("calendar_heatmap", options, { type: "calendar", days, week_start, day_labels, low_color, high_color })
rows.supportedCombinations: ISO YYYY-MM-DD UTC days spanning up to ten years, week_start 0..6, host-supplied day labels, two-color linear scale with in-canvas legend
rows.differences: Days are UTC calendar days; Aeris does not apply a local time zone. Days without a value draw an empty cell and have no hit region, as in ECharts. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms the column/row placement of probe days across the year against convertToPixel. Keyboard focus moves one week with Left/Right and one day with Up/Down. Piecewise visual maps, vertical orientation and calibrated visual review remain open.

rows.capability: Marimekko: variable-width 100% stacked columns, labels, hits, per-segment legend
rows.referenceApi: series.custom renderItem rect on value xAxis/yAxis
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_timeline_calendar.spec.mjs Marimekko width/share pair; general_layout.rs marimekko hit, tooltip and legend tests; persistence.rs layout round trip
rows.supportedCombinations: Non-negative column/segment/value cells; column width proportional to column total, segment height proportional to its share of the column
rows.differences: ECharts has no Marimekko series; the reference is a custom series. Aeris draws an in-canvas legend with one entry per segment in place of the series-toggle legend. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms normalized x offset, width and height of every cell. Legend toggling of segments and calibrated visual review remain open.

rows.capability: Waterfall: relative increase/decrease steps, subtotal and total bars, running base, connectors, per-kind colors, labels, both orientations
rows.owner: aeris_charts_engine general_series.rs waterfall rows and geometry; frame/general_series_geometry.rs paint; WASM/TypeScript waterfall rows and typed columns
rows.referenceApi: series.bar stack with a transparent placeholder series under the visible step series, per-item itemStyle colors, label position top/right, yAxis inverse for the horizontal panel
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_business.spec.mjs vertical and horizontal waterfall pairs (extents, category order, step colors, connectors on/off, labels, typed detail, keyboard announcements); general_business_tests.rs running totals, subtotal/total reset, hit, tooltip, persistence
rows.aerisApi: add_series("waterfall", { waterfall: { increase_color, decrease_color, subtotal_color, total_color, connectors } }) with rows { x, y, step: "relative" | "subtotal" | "total" } or set_data_typed({ categories, values, steps })
rows.supportedCombinations: Band category axis with a linear value axis in either orientation; signed relative steps; subtotal and total rows that ignore y; row colors; data labels; one waterfall per category slot
rows.differences: ECharts has no waterfall series; its recipe stacks a transparent placeholder under the visible bar and the host computes the running total. Aeris takes the steps directly, computes running totals in the engine, and returns { mark, start, end } in tooltip, hit and accessibility detail. Subtotal bars draw the running total from zero like totals. Connector lines join each bar's end to the next bar. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms normalized bar extents, category order and step colors against convertToPixel. Grouped or stacked waterfalls and calibrated visual review remain open.

rows.capability: Bullet graph: qualitative bands, measure bar, target marker, optional comparative measure, both orientations
rows.owner: aeris_charts_engine general_series.rs bullet geometry; frame/general_series_geometry.rs paint; WASM/TypeScript bullet rows and typed columns
rows.referenceApi: series.custom renderItem rects for three bands, comparative, measure and target on a value xAxis and inverse category yAxis
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_business.spec.mjs horizontal and vertical bullet pairs (band edges, measure, comparative, target, thickness ratio, typed detail); general_business_tests.rs geometry, missing parts, hit, tooltip and persistence
rows.aerisApi: add_series("bullet", options) with rows { x, y, target, comparative?, bands? } or set_data_typed({ categories, measure, target, comparative, bands })
rows.supportedCombinations: Band category axis with a linear value axis in either orientation; up to three ascending band thresholds; optional comparative and target per row; row measure colors
rows.differences: ECharts has no bullet series; the reference is a custom series with the same Stephen Few proportions (bands full slot, comparative one half, measure one third, target two thirds by 2 px). Aeris band colors derive from the theme text color so they read on light and dark surfaces. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms normalized band edges, measure, comparative and target positions and the measure thickness ratio in both orientations. More than three bands and calibrated visual review remain open.

rows.capability: Lollipop (stem plus head on column and horizontal_bar) and dumbbell (connector plus two ends on range_bar)
rows.owner: aeris_charts_engine general_series.rs bar_mark option, stem hit distance; frame/general_series_geometry.rs paint
rows.referenceApi: series.bar barWidth 2 plus series.scatter symbolSize 12; stacked transparent bar plus 2 px connector bar plus two scatter series
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_business.spec.mjs vertical and horizontal lollipop and dumbbell pairs (head positions, baselines, head width, connector runs); general_business_tests.rs stem paint, hit and validation
rows.aerisApi: add_series("column" | "horizontal_bar", { bar_mark: "lollipop", point_symbol, point_radius }); add_series("range_bar", { bar_mark: "dumbbell", point_symbol, point_radius })
rows.supportedCombinations: Unstacked column/horizontal_bar lollipops in either orientation; vertical or horizontal range_bar dumbbells; circle, square, diamond and triangle symbols
rows.differences: ECharts composes these from two or more series; Aeris draws one series with one hit target per row, and hover/selection, tooltip and accessibility address the row instead of a separate stem and head. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms normalized head positions, baselines and head width against convertToPixel. Stacked lollipops are rejected. Calibrated visual review remains open.

rows.capability: Slope chart end labels with collision avoidance; bump chart rank transform with dense/competition ties on a top-down rank axis
rows.owner: aeris_charts_engine general_series.rs end_labels/rank options and general_series_ranks; general_axes.rs rank domain and default reversal; frame/general_series_geometry.rs end-label spreading
rows.referenceApi: series.line with first/last point labels and labelLayout moveOverlap shiftY; series.line of host-computed dense ranks on an inverse value yAxis min 0.5 max N+0.5
rows.aerisFixture: tests/g9_business.spec.mjs slope marker and end-label pair (normalized positions, value order, no shared label row) and bump pair (normalized rank positions, rank 1 at top, typed rank detail, dense/competition ties, rank announcement); general_business_tests.rs rank ties, spreading and validation
rows.supportedCombinations: Category point or band X axes with any number of xy_line series; end labels on one or both sides; ranks among visible ranked xy_line series sharing pane and axes, largest value rank 1
rows.differences: ECharts needs host-computed ranks and an explicitly inverted axis; Aeris ranks inside the engine, spans the rank axis 0.5..N+0.5 for N ranked series, and puts rank 1 at the top unless the axis is reversed. Tooltips and accessibility report both the rank and the original value. Aeris spreads end labels vertically with a fixed gap inside the plot; ECharts shifts overlapping labels. A Chromium/Firefox/WebKit pair confirms normalized marker positions, label order and label separation. Labels are not truncated when wider than the outer padding, so hosts reserve room with band_padding_outer; calibrated visual review remains open.
